# Bernal Landscape Management, LLC

> Family-owned landscape design, hardscaping, and property care serving Grand Rapids and West Michigan since 2010. BBB A+ accredited. Fully insured.

## Quick Facts

- Phone: 616-477-1221
- Email: salvador@bernallandscape.com
- Address: 18 36th St SW Suite C, Wyoming, MI 49548
- Hours: Mon–Sat 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Sunday Closed
- Founded: 2010
- Owner: Salvador Bernal
- BBB: A+ Accredited

## Services

- Landscape Design & Installation
- Retaining Wall Construction
- Concrete Construction (driveways, walkways, flatwork)
- Paver Patio Installation
- Lawn Maintenance (mowing, edging, fertilization, aeration)
- Snow Plowing & Shoveling
- Sod Installation
- Tree Service (pruning, canopy care)
- Tree Removal
- Leaf Cleanup
- Yard Drain Installation
- French Drains
- Mulching

## Service Areas

Grand Rapids, Wyoming, Kentwood, Walker, Grandville, Byron Center, Caledonia, Cutlerville, Forest Hills, Ada, Cascade, Hudsonville, Jenison, Comstock Park, Rockford, Allendale, East Grand Rapids — all in West Michigan.
